What a NEW address is shown next (a password to set, or a code sent by email) was not observed — look at the next screen before filling it. A code sent by email or text belongs to the account owner: hand it off.
The account host depends on region: the unprefixed account.battle.net sent a visitor to kr.account.battle.net, so start from the us. host.
